english.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual choice when someone is baffled or cannot make sense of something.
Use this when someone is confused because they do not understand information or what is happening.

examples.english: After they finished explaining all that jargon, I was completely puzzled.
examples.traditional: 佢講完嗰堆專業術語，我即刻一頭霧水。

examples.english: All those technical terms have left me confused.
examples.traditional: 你講咁多專有名詞，搞到我一頭霧水。
